faq.a: The combo includes 4 hours of deep-sea fishing (typically 8am–12pm) and 4 hours of sunset cruising (5pm–9pm) on the Mangusta 80. All fishing gear, bait, and a licensed skipper are provided. Drinks, light snacks, fuel, insurance, and 21% Spanish VAT are included. A jet ski is also included free of charge.

faq.q: Which boat is used for the combo charter?
faq.a: The combo is available on the Mangusta 80, a 24-metre motor yacht that accommodates up to 12 guests. It departs from Puerto Banús and features spacious decks, a flybridge, and a jet ski included free. The boat is equipped with professional trolling tackle and a fighting chair.

faq.q: What fish can we catch during the fishing part?

data.body_html:
Experience the best of both worlds with a Marbella fishing and sunset combo charter 2031. Spend the morning chasing bluefin tuna and dorado off the Costa del Sol, then relax as the sun dips behind La Concha during an evening cruise. This full-day experience departs from Puerto Banús aboard the Mangusta 80, a 24-metre motor yacht that accommodates up to 12 guests. All fishing gear, a licensed skipper, drinks, snacks, and a jet ski are included. Prices start from €4,719 for 4 hours, with the full 8-hour combo from €9,438.

Why choose a fishing and sunset combo charter in Marbella?

This combo charter solves the classic holiday dilemma: should you fish or watch the sunset? You don’t have to choose. The morning session targets pelagic species in the Alboran Sea, while the afternoon turns into a luxurious coastal cruise. It’s ideal for groups with mixed interests—anglers get their fix, and sun-seekers enjoy swimming, jet skiing, and sunset views. The Mangusta 80’s spacious flybridge and bow loungers make it easy to switch between action and relaxation.

Which boat is used for the combo charter?

The combo is exclusively available on the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax, departs Puerto Banús). This yacht features a large cockpit with a fighting chair, a flybridge with sun pads, and a jet ski included free. It’s powered by twin MTU engines for a cruising speed of 24 knots, meaning you reach the fishing grounds in under 20 minutes. The boat is equipped with trolling rods, Penn reels, and a live bait well. A professional skipper with local knowledge handles all navigation and fishing techniques.

What’s included in the price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and 21% Spanish VAT. Fishing gear (trolling rods, lures, gaff, bait) is provided at no extra cost. The jet ski is included free for the sunset portion. There are no hidden fees: the price you see is the price you pay. For the Mangusta 80, the minimum charter is 4 hours at €4,719. The full 8-hour combo (4h fishing + 4h sunset) is approximately €9,438.

Fishing part: what to expect

Your fishing leg runs from 8am to 12pm. The skipper will head 5–10 NM offshore to the best grounds off Marbella, Cabopino, or Estepona. Target species include bluefin tuna (up to 100kg), dorado, dentex, amberjack, and bonito. Trolling with artificial lures and live bait is the primary technique. The boat has a fighting chair and a gaff for landing larger fish. Catch-and-release is encouraged, but you can keep your catch for local restaurants to prepare. All fishing permits are covered by the boat’s commercial license.

Sunset cruise: what to expect

The sunset portion runs from 5pm to 9pm. You’ll cruise along the Marbella coastline, passing the Golden Mile, Puerto Banús, and the dunes of Cabopino. The skipper will anchor at Cala Cortés or Cala del Faro for swimming and jet skiing. Drinks and snacks are served throughout. As the sun sets behind La Concha mountain, you’ll have prime photo opportunities. The return to Puerto Banús is at dusk, with the marina lights reflecting on the water.

How to book your Marbella fishing and sunset combo charter 2031

Booking is simple. Contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and any special requests. We’ll confirm availability and send a quote. A 50% deposit secures the booking, with the balance due 7 days before departure. The combo is popular, especially in summer, so early booking is recommended. For other boat options, see our full fleet or explore experiences.
